title: Anthropic is paying $15 billion a year for access to Elon Musk’s data centers
raw_excerpt: Earlier this month, SpaceX and Anthropic announced a new compute partnership that provides access to the rocket company's Colossus data centers in Memphis, TN. Now, with the release of SpaceX's IPO filing , we have more details about that deal, including how much Anthropic is paying to Elon Musk's company. In its S-1 filing, SpaceX said that Anthropic agreed to pay $1.25 billion per month through May 2029 for access to SpaceX's AI training centers at Colossus I and Colossus II. That's $15 billion annually, which could nearly double the $18.7 billion in revenue that SpaceX reported in all of 2025. summary: SpaceX IPO文件披露，Anthropic以每月12.5亿美元（年化150亿美元）租用SpaceX的Colossus数据中心算力，合同至2029年5月。这笔交易几乎相当于SpaceX 2024全年营收的80%，凸显顶级AI公司对算力的疯狂渴求。

title: OpenAI Reportedly Moves Toward IPO
raw_excerpt: OpenAI is reportedly preparing for a potential IPO as early as September following the dismissal of Elon Musk's lawsuit challenging the company's structure.
summary: OpenAI据报最快于9月启动IPO，此前马斯克诉讼被驳回为其扫清障碍。若成行，这将是近年来最受瞩目的科技公司上市事件，估值可能超过2000亿美元。

title: Stable Audio 3.0
raw_excerpt: Stability AI released a new family of Stable Audio 3.0 models, including open-weight versions capable of generating music and sound effects up to more than six minutes long.
summary: Stability AI发布Stable Audio 3.0模型家族，包含开放权重版本，可生成最长6分钟以上的音乐和音效。这是音频生成领域的重要进展，开源策略有望推动社区创新。

title: Lance Unified Multimodal Model (GitHub Repo)
raw_excerpt: Lance is a 3B multimodal model from ByteDance capable of image and video understanding, generation, and editing within a single architecture trained entirely from scratch.
summary: 字节跳动开源Lance，一个3B参数的多模态模型，能在单一架构内完成图像/视频理解、生成和编辑，且完全从头训练。该模型在多项基准上表现优异，为统一多模态模型提供了新思路。

title: WavFlow Generates Audio Directly in Waveform Space (GitHub Repo)
raw_excerpt: WavFlow is a flow-matching framework from Meta AI that generates synchronized audio from video and text inputs directly in raw waveform space without relying on latent audio compression.
summary: Meta AI开源WavFlow，一个流匹配框架，可直接在原始波形空间从视频和文本输入生成同步音频，无需依赖潜在音频压缩。这为视频配音和音频生成提供了更高质量的新方法。

title: Introducing Agent Executor, Google's distributed Agent Runtime
raw_excerpt: Google Agent Executor is an open-source runtime standard for reliable and efficient execution of long-running agent workflows. Key features like durable execution, secure isolation, and connection recovery enhance workflow management, while session consistency and trajectory branching support distributed agent environments. It also collaborates with Kubernetes Engine on Agent Substrate to optimize compute efficiency for massive agent deployments.
summary: Google发布Agent Executor，一个开源的分布式Agent运行时标准，支持持久化执行、安全隔离、连接恢复和轨迹分支，并与Kubernetes集成以优化大规模Agent部署的算力效率。

title: Meta lays off thousands of employees to offset AI investments

title: Alibaba unveils new AI chip in push for domestic alternatives
raw_excerpt: Alibaba's new chip, the Zhenwu M890, is well-suited to handle the heavy memory and communication demands of AI agent workloads.
summary: 阿里巴巴发布自研AI芯片“真武M890”，专为AI Agent工作负载设计，擅长处理高内存和通信需求。此举是中国科技巨头在AI芯片领域自主替代的重要一步，有望降低对进口芯片的依赖。
